answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-vested identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit that vests gradually, the way water carves a canyon drop by drop rather than in one flood. At the dawn of each epoch, brand-new identities hold zero trust and must earn it through verified useful work, while the per-identity cost stays identical for everyone. Mass-spawned fake identities burn through like a comet -- bright at first, then gone before any stake matures.
